dedupe_keys.name: towards holistic wind farm design optimization an integrated multidisciplinary approach

description: Italiano, Nicolò and colleagues describe this resource in the native deposit. The implemented formulation couples turbine placement, support structures, electricity collection layout and farm control while accounting for day-ahead price variation. A reported case compares joint and sequential designs and attributes the main gain to placement, collection and control coupling. The abstract does not identify a real site, so this record represents the documented optimisation model. The result is conditional on the tested design and market assumptions, not a general guarantee of improved commercial project returns. Zenodo provides the deposit with open access under cc-by-4.0. The source establishes an implemented or evaluated model. Public source-code availability remains unknown unless explicitly identified below. Coverage is limited to the stated experiment, model or application; transfer to other turbines, sites or operating regimes requires separate assessment. Publication date alone does not establish current maintenance. The optimisation is based on the combination of layout, support structure, collection and operational choices.
